title: Siting Sports Stadium within Housing Estates
what_it_is: Siting Sports Stadium within Housing Estates

sections.label: Master Plan sporting facilities
sections.summary: The Master Plan provides sporting and recreational facilities for national, regional and local town needs, with SportSG considering factors like population size and utilisation rates.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
sentences.text: The Master Plan comprises a range of sporting and recreational facilities that meet national, regional and local town needs.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
sentences.text: We provide for every Housing and Development Board (HDB) Town to have either a Town Sports Centre or Regional Sports Centre, and depending on population trends, may also be supplemented with a Town Play Field.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
sentences.text: In determining what specific facilities to put in the towns, SportSG takes into account a variety of considerations, such as the town population size, popularity of sports, utilisation rates, availability of space, proximity to other sport and recreational amenities, as well as feedback from residents.
